Original Description(From Musescore):
Transcriptions of the music from all of the cutscenes in the DLC, plus the little bonus bit at the end. I did all of these by ear, but I used Nomax's piano arrangement of The Champion's Ballad as a reference for that cutscene. (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LzHxXiIcCME)

1. Champion Revali's Song
2. Champion Urbosa's Song
3. Champion Daruk's Song
4. Champion Mipha's Song
5. The Champions' Ballad
6. At Home

I'M NOT CRYING YOU'RE CRYING
